title: Kawah Ijen
description: This turquoise lake looks perfect, and it is full of acid. Kawah Ijen on Java is the largest highly acidic crater lake in the world. Would you go down there? Imagery: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics. Photos: CEphoto, Uwe Aranas (CC BY-SA 3.0), Semhur (CC BY-SA 4.0), Wikimedia Commons. Source: Wikipedia.

beats.text: This turquoise lake looks perfect, and it is full of acid.
It is Kawah Ijen, inside a volcano on the island of Java.
It is the largest highly acidic crater lake in the world.
An explorer once rowed a rubber boat across it, just to measure the acid.
The lake is two hundred meters deep.
Men still climb down here to mine sulfur, and carry it out by hand.
And at night, burning sulfur gas lights the crater with blue fire.
